schema.title: KYC Screening Results
schema.description: Output of the OpenSanctions screening agents. One screening batch per entity/case. Persisted and displayed; foreign-keyed to the KYC Master Attribute Schema.

entity_id.description: Foreign key to KYC Master Attribute Schema entity_id.

case_id.description: Foreign key to KYC Master Attribute Schema case_id.

screening_timestamp.description: ISO datetime when this screening batch was executed.

screening_config.description: Parameters used for this screening run.

score_threshold.description: Minimum match score threshold applied (0.0 to 1.0).

screening_results.description: One entry per screened party. Parties with zero matches still appear with an empty matches array.

party_role.description: Which KYC Master array this party comes from.

party_index.description: Zero-based index within the KYC Master array. Null for party_role entity.

party_name.description: Name as submitted to screening for traceability.

query_properties.description: FtM properties submitted to /match. Keys are FtM property names, values are arrays of strings.

alias.description: Alternative names / trading names / previous names submitted. From FtM properties.alias.

taxNumber.description: Tax ID numbers submitted. From FtM properties.taxNumber.

gender.description: Gender submitted (Person only). From FtM properties.gender.

matches.description: Ranked match results from OpenSanctions /match API.

schema.description: FtM entity type of the matched entity.

caption.description: Display name of the matched entity.

target.description: True if direct target (sanctioned or PEP). False if contextual or linked.

score.description: Match confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) from /match API.

match.description: Whether the API considers this a confirmed match at configured threshold.

topics.description: Risk tags: sanction, sanction.linked, role.pep, role.rca, poi, debarment, reg.action, reg.warn, corp.disqual.

datasets.description: Source dataset IDs (e.g. us_ofac_sdn, eu_fsf, gb_fcdo_sanctions).

matched_name.description: All known name variants from properties.name.

matched_programId.description: Sanctions program IDs from properties.programId (e.g. EU-UKR, US-RUSHAR).

first_seen.description: ISO datetime when entity first appeared in OpenSanctions.

last_seen.description: ISO datetime of most recent observation.

explanation_name_score.description: Name match feature score from explanations.name_match.score.

explanation_name_detail.description: Name match detail string from explanations.name_match.detail.

explanation_dob_score.description: DOB match feature score from explanations.dob_year_disjoint.score.

explanation_dob_detail.description: DOB match detail string from explanations.dob_year_disjoint.detail.

disposition_status.description: Current disposition state of this match.

discount_rules_applied.description: Rules that fired to evaluate this match.

rule_id.description: Rule identifier (e.g. DOB_MISMATCH, NATIONALITY_MISMATCH, GENDER_MISMATCH, SCORE_BELOW_THRESHOLD, EXACT_NAME_MATCH).

details.description: Comparison details (e.g. Query DOB 1975-03-12 vs candidate 1951-12-01).

analyst_decision.description: Human override decision if applicable. Null until an analyst reviews this match.

analyst_notes.description: Analyst commentary on this match. Null until reviewed.

decision_timestamp.description: ISO datetime of disposition decision. Null until reviewed.
